What Wikicasts does
From anywhere

Start from Wikipedia, any link you paste, or today’s news.

Follow along

Read along if you like. Every word lights up as it’s said.

Hosts you like the sound of

Mix and match voices, in the accent you’d like to hear.

A conversation or a narration

Two hosts talk it through, or one voice reads it as written.

Ambience, your way

A soft sound under the voices. Turn it up, down or off.

iPhone and the web

On your phone or computer. Sign in and your casts follow.

Share what you make

Send a cast as a link. Anyone can press play, no app needed.
